Implement the planned tool in `src/tools/uuid/`.

- Generate v4 (`crypto.randomUUID`) and v7 (time-ordered, implement per RFC 9562)
- Choose count (1–100), with options for uppercase and no-hyphens
- Copy-all button
- Tests: format/version/variant bits for both, and v7 values generated in sequence sort correctly
- Set status to `ready`
